card.name: Zero digit in platelet count thresholds
card.fires_on: The digit 0 (or 9) right after a leading 1 or similar digit inside a number, mostly in platelet count cutoffs such as 100,000 cells/mm3. It also appears in some other measurements.

modes.label: Platelet count cutoffs
modes.description: The 0 inside 100,000 or 90,000 in blood count thresholds for holding or giving a drug.
modes.example: platelet count is at least 1<<0>>0,000 cells/mm

modes.label: Other measurements
modes.description: A 0 within a size or length figure outside lab values.

card.writes: It promotes digit tokens, so it pushes the next piece of the number to be another digit.
card.plain: It fires on the zero in round numbers like 100,000 in blood count limits, predicting more digits.
